$comment: What the kb (scripts/kb) launches with the GitHub token. /project-init (vc-init write-secrets-decl.mjs) declares these in .claude/vc-secrets.local.json, bound to the github axis secret; `vc-secrets trust` approves them. The server relaunches itself through `kb`, the Stop hook and `npm run kb -- push` through `kb-push` (scripts/kb/core/via-secrets.mjs).
